items.text: For each platform export an independently reproducible inventory of all external initializer and method parameters, results, properties, subscripts and enum payloads. Walk type aliases, optionals, arrays, generic arguments and constraints. Fail on a failed or empty export or missing sentinel. Seed leaks through an initializer, a result and a property and report each declaring symbol and the referenced type.

Record existing violations per declaration on each platform, including HostEndpoint in PairingOffer.init and AddressFailure.init. An external client importing only DSHCore reads a domain snapshot. Record baseline compiler results for host.addresses.first?.webSocketURL() and CachedTask.stateRaw. Prove that a new leak or a stale allowlist entry fails the check.
Starting from an uninstalled app and an empty local store at the baseline, launch, pair with a test bridge and create the first task. Record the visible result and the baseline revision.
